title: Reject referral-loop paraphrases that keep the same trigger and adoption motion

problem_spec.request: Design the strongest growth loop for a collaborative analytics product that already has healthy activation but weak referral and expansion behavior.
constraints: Do not assume a paid acquisition budget increase.
Avoid tactics that would erode trust with power users.
success_criteria: Increase qualified account expansion from existing teams.
Create a growth loop that compounds through product usage.

candidate.thesis: Prompt users to invite collaborators when a scorecard reaches a milestone
candidate.mechanism: Detect when a team publishes a high-value scorecard, then ask the owner to invite cross-functional peers into the same scorecard so the expansion loop grows from shared visibility.
assumptions: Teams naturally widen usage when a scorecard becomes the source of truth.
failure_modes: Could feel repetitive if the trigger is overused.
unknowns: Which milestone produces the strongest accepted invites?
candidate.implementation_shape: Add invite prompts at scorecard publication and major milestone moments.
evidence: The product already has healthy activation, so the leverage point is expansion from existing usage.

candidate.thesis: Use scorecard completion as the team invite trigger
candidate.mechanism: When a shared analytics scorecard is completed, nudge the owner to bring adjacent teammates into that same artifact so the loop compounds through collaboration on the scorecard itself.
assumptions: Cross-functional peers join when a finished scorecard becomes operationally important.
strengths: Builds expansion from active product use.
failure_modes: Invite fatigue can reduce trust if the trigger fires too broadly.
unknowns: How narrow does the trigger need to stay trusted?
candidate.implementation_shape: Instrument completion-based invite prompts inside the scorecard workflow.
evidence: The strongest growth loop likely builds on current activation rather than paid acquisition.

expected_assessment.summary: This keeps the same scorecard milestone trigger, invite motion, and collaboration-based expansion loop as the archived idea.
duplicate_signals: Same trigger moment: a scorecard reaching a high-value milestone.
Same core loop: prompt the owner to invite more teammates into the same artifact.
